paragraphs: R. Yehudah bar Titem. R. Acha in R. Elazar's name: Jerusalem Berakhot, chapter 3, mishnah 4. R. Chama said Yehudah ben Titus was at Rome, and they appointed him an elder on condition that he return (to the Land of Israel): Bikkurim, chapter 3, end of halakhah 4. [The checked edition places the report at 3:3:19 and leaves the destination implicit.] R. Yehudah ben Pazi and Shimon bar Ba, in R. Yochanan's name: Shemonah Sheratzim, halakhah 2. [The checked witness names Yehudah ben Titus alongside them in this chain.] The rabbis of Caesarea, in R. Yudah bar Sitas's name: end of chapter 5 of Sheviit; Gittin, end of HaNizzakin. [The checked Sheviit reads bar Titus and the checked Gittin reads ben Titus.] In R. Acha's name: end of HaChalil.
